summary.en: An Act to make provision for the payment of a service charge by airport

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-188-2021-ED-AIRPORT-PASSENGER-SERVICE-CHARGE-ACT.pdf》（8 页），本次切分 5 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Act may be cited as the Airport Passenger Service Charge Act.

(1) Save as otherwise provided in this Act, a passenger service charge shall by payable at the rates specified in the Schedule by each passenger embarking on an aircraft taking off from an airport for a destination outside Brunei Darussalam.

(2) In subsection (I), "airport" means an airport, aerodrome or landing ground in Brunei Darussalam, owned and operated by the Government.
The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by order amend the Schedule.

The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, make rules for giving effect to the objects and purposes of this Act and for the due administration thereof. Airport Passenger Service Churge CAP. 188 7
